mapper.select: SELECT c.command_id, c.state, c.payload_json, e.fact_line_id AS line_id, l.order_id, l.sku_id, l.base_unit, o.owner_id FROM source_command c JOIN source_effect e ON e.id=c.business_effect_key AND e.enterprise_id=c.enterprise_id AND e.warehouse_id=c.warehouse_id AND e.action=c.action JOIN inbound_line l ON l.id=e.fact_line_id AND l.enterprise_id=c.enterprise_id AND l.warehouse_id=c.warehouse_id JOIN inbound_order o ON o.id=l.order_id AND o.enterprise_id=l.enterprise_id AND o.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id WHERE c.enterprise_id=#{ent} AND c.warehouse_id=#{wh} AND c.command_id=#{receipt} AND c.action='RECEIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbound_receipt_quality (id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,receipt_command_id,inbound_line_id,state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{id},#{ent},#{wh},#{receipt},#{line},'OPEN',#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT id,receipt_command_id,inbound_line_id,source_version,applied_version,accepted_qty,rejected_qty, putaway_qty,active_command_id,state,version FROM inbound_receipt_quality WHERE enterprise_id=#{ent} AND warehouse_id=#{wh} AND receipt_command_id=#{receipt} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inbound_task SET receipt_command_id=#{receipt},source_location_id=#{location},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{ent} AND warehouse_id=#{wh} AND id=#{task} AND receipt_command_id IS NULL AND completed_qty=0
mapper.select: SELECT c.command_id AS id,e.fact_line_id AS lineId,c.state AS stockSyncStatus,c.payload_json, COALESCE(q.source_version,0) AS qualitySourceVersion,COALESCE(q.applied_version,0) AS qualityAppliedVersion, COALESCE(q.accepted_qty,0) AS acceptedQty,COALESCE(q.rejected_qty,0) AS rejectedQty, COALESCE(q.putaway_qty,0) AS putawayQty,COALESCE(q.state,'OPEN') AS qualityState FROM inbound_line l JOIN source_effect e ON e.enterprise_id=l.enterprise_id AND e.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id AND e.fact_line_id=l.id AND e.source_service='wms-inbound' AND e.action='RECEIVE' JOIN source_command c ON c.business_effect_key=e.id AND c.enterprise_id=e.enterprise_id AND c.warehouse_id=e.warehouse_id AND c.action=e.action AND (c.command_id=e.active_command_id OR c.command_id=e.applied_command_id) LEFT JOIN inbound_receipt_quality q ON q.enterprise_id=c.enterprise_id AND q.warehouse_id=c.warehouse_id AND q.receipt_command_id=c.command_id WHERE l.enterprise_id=#{ent} AND l.warehouse_id=#{wh} AND l.order_id=#{order} AND c.command_id > #{page.id} ORDER BY c.command_id LIMIT #{page.fetchLimit}
